title: Creator Identity Map™
intro: Turn what you're already creating into a clear creative identity you can build infrastructure around.

nodes.section: Step 1 — Inventory Your Mediums and Methods
nodes.prompt: List every format your creative work has taken, however minor.
What subject, question, feeling, or method shows up across almost everything you've made?
What would someone who has seen several of your pieces say you're "always doing"?
What are you actually doing through your medium? Complete: I use [your medium] to …

nodes.prompt: FOUNDATIONS — What is the thread, plainly stated?

nodes.section: Step 4 — Build the Identity Statement, Phase By Phase
nodes.prompt: INFRASTRUCTURE PLANNING & MANAGEMENT — Who does this identity actually serve or reach?

nodes.section: Step 4 — Build the Identity Statement, Phase By Phase
nodes.prompt: INTERNAL OPERATING SYSTEMS — How does this identity show up consistently in the work you release?
